historicalWorkflowArchive.policy: The complete pre-R170 workflow directory remains byte-addressable in immutable Git history at the recorded commit/tree. Superseded YAMLs are removed only from the active Actions directory; their source and lineage are not erased.

truthLaw: reachable != writable != executed != returned != verified != promoted != Canon-admitted
truthBoundary: R170 may autonomously observe, select a predefined low/medium-risk implementation capsule, generate one additive candidate, run the current proof chain, push an isolated branch, and open a PR. R170 cannot directly mutate main, cannot auto-merge, cannot repair HIGH/CRITICAL truth gaps autonomously, cannot claim a PC online without current device proof, cannot elevate R153.2 beyond SCREEN_ONLY, cannot claim the protected Living Light Vercel surface writable, and cannot admit CanonState outside R125.
